about: Say hello (morning!) to a new kind of rhythm game, and hang out in a virtual space with Kizuna AI!
Kizuna AI: Touch the Beat is a rhythm game that features Kizuna AI.
Play in VR mode, or in a non-VR mode that does not require PlayStation®VR2 / PlayStation®VR.
This edition also includes a View Mode, which lets you travel through the game's stages free as a bird.
If you want to hang out with Kizuna AI in VR, Kizuna AI: Touch the Beat is for you!
It goes without saying that this game can be played on both your TV and with PlayStation®VR2.
Includes 15 popular songs performed by Kizuna AI, including her massive hit "Hello, Morning," which has garnered over 2,170,000 views.
Post-launch DLC is in the works, including additional songs and outfits, and other content.
summary: Say hello (morning!) to a new kind of rhythm game, and hang out in a virtual space with Kizuna AI!
